task_instance: Generate a production-ready, secure, multi-stage Dockerfile and a .dockerignore for a small Node.js/Express JSON API (sample project: package.json with engines node>=20 and an express dependency, src/index.js binding to process.env.PORT||3000, and a .env.example).
evidence: Created a realistic sample project under the work directory (sample-app/package.json, sample-app/src/index.js, sample-app/.env.example). Performed the skill's Step 1 analysis by reading those files: language Node.js, version pinned to 20 from the engines constraint, framework Express (web API), runtime port 3000 derived from process.env.PORT||3000 in index.js, no transpile/build step, no external system binaries invoked, PORT the only (optional, defaulted) env var. Wrote the two deliverables: sample-app/Dockerfile and sample-app/.dockerignore. Verified the Dockerfile by inspection against every item of the skill's Dockerfile, .dockerignore and Success-Criteria checklists: two named stages (builder -> runtime) on pinned node:20-alpine (no :latest), production-only dependency install (npm install --omit=dev) with npm cache cleaned in the same RUN layer, dependency manifest copied before source for cache locality, explicit COPY of node_modules/package.json/src (no 'COPY . .'), dedicated non-root group+user at UID/GID 10001 with ownership set and USER before CMD, EXPOSE 3000 only because the port was found in source, exec-form CMD ["node","src/index.js"], alpine (apk, --no-cache) so no apt flags needed, no secrets/ENV credentials, no debugging tools, and no HEALTHCHECK per the absolute prohibition. The .dockerignore is 11 lines excluding only host node_modules, .env secrets (keeping .env.example), .git and build/test caches. The skill's optional Step 4 docker build/run/hadolint/trivy validation loop was not executed because it requires a shell and the docker CLI, which the office-assistant runtime does not provide; the text deliverables themselves (the Dockerfile and .dockerignore) were fully produced and checklist-verified, which is the skill's core stated deliverable.
